protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol name declared by the grammar (e.g. 'HL7').

desc.title: Desc
desc.description: Free-text description of the segment, if provided by the grammar.

index.title: Index
index.description: 1-based position of the field within its segment.

type.title: Type
type.description: Field data type, if declared in the grammar.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether the field is required by the grammar.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Ordered fields defined for this segment.

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: Deduplicated segments defined by the grammar.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Message types keyed by name, each mapped to the flattened list of segment names that make up its layout.

schemas.title: Schemas
schemas.description: Parsed grammar schemas found in the node's directory, keyed by schema filename (e.g. 'demo.json').
